title: Domino and Tromino Tilings for Large N
description: You have two types of tiles: a `2 x 1` domino shape and an L-shaped tromino (3 cells) that may be rotated in any orientation. Given a positive 64-bit integer `n`, return the number of distinct ways to completely tile a `2 x n` board with these tiles, modulo `10^9 + 7`.
hints: The number of tilings satisfies the 3rd-order linear recurrence `f(n) = 2 * f(n - 1) + f(n - 3)` with base values `f(0) = 1`, `f(1) = 1`, and `f(2) = 2`.
Express the recurrence as a `3 x 3` transition matrix `[[2, 0, 1], [1, 0, 0], [0, 1, 0]]` and raise it to the power `n - 2` modulo `10^9 + 7` via binary matrix exponentiation.

examples.explanation: For a 2 x 3 board, there are 5 valid domino/tromino tilings.
For a 2 x 1 board, only a single vertical domino fits (1 way).
